P01.note2: Walled is rejected on the incidental fact that the dyed banks are natural; the rejection should rest on the wheel turning in the open current with the whole stream running past it, so nothing enclosed or hemmed in the stream.

P07.note2: Junction is read only as a pass-through point, when its ordinary sense is a meeting or joining place (here, of the two neighbourhoods the yard divided); the rejection should rest on residents being only a tenth of the crowd, which the explanation spends on mixer instead.

P16.note2: Bedroom is rejected only in its sleeping sense (active at dusk, gone in a week), when its figurative mating-place sense fits exactly the spawning the explanation itself cites (females a fifth lighter from shedding eggs); a rejection would have to rest on the courtship display (crowds circling) that makes ballroom more precise, and even then bedroom stays defensible.

P25.note2: Kitchen is rejected because shrimp 'near the outlet' ate plankton, but the passage says only 'nearby shrimp', and plankton-fed shrimp near the marsh are as consistent with the marsh feeding the bay as against it; the passage plants no fact that actually rules kitchen out.

P30.note2: Herded is rejected only in its driving sense ('never moved the aphids'), when herding also means keeping a flock together and in place, which is exactly the outcome the passage reports (tended aphids stayed put while untended ones scattered); drugged is the more precise word for the chemical slowing, but herded remains defensible and the rejection does not rule it out.

P31.note2: Mantled is rejected only in its deposit-layer sense, but the glacier itself covered the valley floor for several thousand years, which is the literal sense of mantled; the rejection should rest on the question being about what the glacier left on the floor (boulders scattered on old soil), not on the absence of a deposited layer.

P33.note2: Parlor is rejected on the incidental detail that he barred the door at sundown; the rejection should rest on there being no social gathering, drinking or entertainment in the store, only doses measured and charged for medicine.
